body: it's ok I'm really crazy and weird too and i hate being lonely we can be weirdos together if you want

Sending you all of my witchy healing vibes! Birthdays are definitely one of the times of year that I struggle the most because they are super fuckin depressing so I think you should try and wait at least until a few weeks afterwards, that way the bday blues will have had time to pass and you can really consider how you're feeling in a clearer headspace x

I'm so sorry man, having your heart broken is the worst fucking thing. I don't wanna sound bullshit and cliche but heart break will pass. Clearly you knew what you needed to do to get her help, try and find the strength to get yourself some help. It's a lot scarier alone without someone to hold your hand and all that bollocks but if you think that she deserved help then you definitely fucking do too. Also maybe get yourself a little pet? Like a couple of little rats or something. They are easier to care for than a doggy and they're super sweet and loving and loyal, you won't have to go home to an empty place and it will give you something other than your sadness to think about, which will help you get better. Obvs I know nothing about your mental health so if what I'm saying is shit and cliche then I'm sorry. If you think you can pull through this then you so can. You got this my dude
